page.title: 直接つかむ？ 前置詞でつなぐ？

analysis.summaryJa: 動詞ごとに対象とのつながり方が異なる。mention/ask/tell/enter/visit/approach/resembleは対象を直接目的語に取り、complain/apologizeは相手をtoで、agreeは人をwithで結ぶ。日本語の助詞から前置詞を足さず、動詞と構文を組で覚える。
visualEvidence: 直接ゲートV+Oと前置詞橋ゲート
誤った余分な前置詞を赤で示す
commonTraps: enter intoを通常の場所到着で使う

questions.prompt: Please mention ------- during the supplier briefing.
questions.translationJa: 仕入先説明会で改訂された期限に言及してください。
questions.explanationJa: mentionは話題を直接目的語に取るためaboutは不要です。

questions.prompt: All visitors must enter ------- through the east entrance.
questions.translationJa: すべての来訪者は東入口から展示ホールへ入らなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: enterは場所を直接目的語に取ります。

questions.prompt: The representative apologized ------- the customer for the billing error.
questions.translationJa: 担当者は請求ミスについて顧客に謝罪しました。
questions.explanationJa: 謝罪する相手はapologize to＋人で示します。

questions.prompt: I agree ------- Ms. Chen that the entrance needs clearer signs.
questions.translationJa: 入口にはもっと分かりやすい標識が必要だという点でチェンさんに同意します。
questions.explanationJa: 人への同意はagree with＋人です。

questions.prompt: The auditor asked ------- several questions about the expense report.
questions.translationJa: 監査担当者は部長に経費報告についていくつか質問しました。
questions.explanationJa: askは質問する相手を直接目的語に取れます。

questions.prompt: Our team visited ------- while attending the trade show.
questions.translationJa: 私たちのチームは展示会参加中に地域事務所を訪問しました。
questions.explanationJa: visitは訪問先を直接目的語に取ります。

questions.prompt: The delivery driver approached ------- slowly because the area was crowded.
questions.translationJa: 混雑していたため、配送運転手は荷捌き場へゆっくり近づきました。
questions.explanationJa: approachは対象を直接目的語に取るのでtoは不要です。

questions.prompt: Several guests complained ------- the front-desk manager about the noise.
questions.translationJa: 数名の宿泊客が騒音についてフロント責任者に苦情を言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 苦情を言う相手はcomplain to＋人で示します。

questions.prompt: The new model closely resembles -------, although its internal design is different.

choices.D: like the previous version after resembles

questions.translationJa: 内部設計は異なりますが、新型は旧型によく似ています。
questions.explanationJa: resembleは『～に似ている』対象を直接目的語に取ります。

questions.prompt: In standard usage, “The consultant explained the issue to us” differs from “The consultant told ------- the issue” because tell takes the person directly.
questions.translationJa: tellでは相手usを直接目的語に取ります。
questions.explanationJa: tell＋人＋内容の構造で、相手の前にtoは置きません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “mention.”

choices.A: The report mentions the staffing shortage.
choices.B: The report mentions about the staffing shortage.
choices.C: The report mentions to the staffing shortage.
choices.D: The report mentions with the staffing shortage.

questions.translationJa: その報告書は人員不足に言及しています。
questions.explanationJa: mention＋話題を直接置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “enter.”

choices.A: Employees entered into the meeting room in ordinary location usage.
choices.B: Employees entered to the meeting room.
choices.C: Employees entered at the meeting room.

questions.translationJa: 従業員は会議室に入りました。
questions.explanationJa: enterは場所を直接目的語にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “apologize.”

choices.B: The hotel apologized to the guest.
choices.C: The hotel apologized with the guest.
choices.D: The hotel apologized at the guest.

questions.translationJa: ホテルは宿泊客に謝罪しました。
questions.explanationJa: 相手はtoでつなぎます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “agree” when the object is a person.

choices.A: I agree to Mr. Lee about this point.
choices.B: I agree Mr. Lee about this point.
choices.C: I agree with Mr. Lee about this point.
choices.D: I agree at Mr. Lee about this point.

questions.translationJa: この点についてリーさんに同意します。
questions.explanationJa: 人に同意する場合agree with＋人です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “visit.”

choices.A: The director visited our branch yesterday.
choices.B: The director visited to our branch yesterday.
choices.C: The director visited at our branch yesterday.
choices.D: The director visited with our branch yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 取締役は昨日、当支店を訪問しました。
questions.explanationJa: visitは訪問先を直接目的語に取ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “approach.”

choices.A: The taxi approached to the hotel.
choices.B: The taxi approached at the hotel.
choices.C: The taxi approached with the hotel.

questions.translationJa: タクシーはホテルに近づきました。
questions.explanationJa: approach＋場所でtoは不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “resemble.”

choices.A: The prototype resembles to the final product.
choices.B: The prototype resembles the final product.
choices.C: The prototype resembles with the final product.
choices.D: The prototype resembles like the final product.

questions.translationJa: 試作品は最終製品に似ています。
questions.explanationJa: resembleは対象を直接目的語に取ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with “complain” and a person.

choices.B: The customer complained with the supervisor as recipient.
choices.C: The customer complained to the supervisor.
choices.D: The customer complained at the supervisor.

questions.translationJa: 顧客は監督者に苦情を述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 相手をcomplain to＋人でつなぎます。

questions.prompt: Choose the best correction of “We approached to the counter.”

choices.D: We approach to counter is always correct.

questions.translationJa: 正しくはWe approached the counter.です。
questions.explanationJa: approachはcounterを直接目的語に取ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly contrasts “tell” and “explain.”

choices.A: Tell to me the procedure; explain me the procedure.
choices.B: Tell me the procedure; explain the procedure to me.
choices.C: Tell with me the procedure; explain to the procedure me.
choices.D: Tell me to the procedure; explain me to procedure.

questions.translationJa: tellは人を直接取り、explainは内容を直接取り相手をtoで示します。
questions.explanationJa: 動詞ごとのつながり方の違いを表す正しい対比です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in structure to: “The memo mentions the deadline.”

choices.A: deadline is the direct object/topic of mentions.
choices.B: about must connect mentions and deadline.

questions.translationJa: deadlineがmentionsの直接の話題・目的語です。
questions.explanationJa: mentionは対象を直接取ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in structure to: “She apologized to the client.”

choices.A: client is a direct object with no relation word.
choices.B: to links the apology action to its recipient.
choices.C: with is required instead of to.

questions.translationJa: toが謝罪行為と相手clientをつないでいます。
questions.explanationJa: apologizeは相手をtoで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in structure to: “They entered the building.”

choices.C: building is the direct object/place of entered.

questions.translationJa: buildingがenteredの直接の場所目的語です。
questions.explanationJa: 通常の『建物に入る』ではenter＋buildingです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in structure to: “We agreed with the consultant.”

choices.A: consultant is directly acted on by agree.
choices.D: with links agreement to the person whose view we share.

questions.translationJa: withが同意と意見を共有する相手を結びます。
questions.explanationJa: 人へのagreeはwithを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager asked me a question.”

choices.A: I was the person directly asked a question by the manager.
choices.D: to me is required after asked.

questions.translationJa: 私は部長から質問を直接された人です。
questions.explanationJa: askは人を直接目的語として取れます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The engineer visited the plant.”

choices.A: The engineer arrived at a different place.
choices.B: The plant was the place directly visited by the engineer.

questions.translationJa: plantが技術者の直接の訪問先でした。
questions.explanationJa: visit＋場所で前置詞は不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The new logo resembles the old one.”

choices.A: The logo agrees with a person.
choices.B: The logo approaches the old one physically.
choices.C: The new logo is similar in appearance to the old one.

questions.translationJa: 新しいロゴは古いロゴと見た目が似ています。
questions.explanationJa: resemble自体が『～に似ている』を表し対象を直接取ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Guests complained to the manager.”

choices.D: The manager was the recipient of the guests' complaints.

questions.translationJa: 部長が宿泊客の苦情を受ける相手でした。
questions.explanationJa: toがcomplainの相手を示します。
